summary: Discussion signals: vendor agent releases (DeepSeek, Grok), Microsoft Intelligent Terminal update, Anthropic watermark/outage chatter, plus operator field reports on MCP, model serving, memory/deduplication and several infra repos needing corroboration. | Vendor announcements: Anthropic Opus 5 launch, Cloudflare agent/MCP/security updates, AWS S3 multi-agent orchestration guide, JetBrains agent how‑to, Modal/Daytona/Vercel product moves. | GitHub OSS snapshot: vendor releases (QwenLM, Vercel, Anthropic, Langfuse) plus notable infra primitives (runtime security, cross-agent memory, agent firewall). Missing social/operator reports for user-workflow signals. | Package-level signals show mainstream vendors shipping CLI/IDE agent packages (OpenAI, GitHub, Amazon) plus a burst of infra primitives: observability/eval, sandbox providers, and VS Code persistent-memory extensions. Missing social/operator reports to validate real-world workflows.
